reasons: A is a long narrative of Hunayn ending with the Prophet's address to the Ansar; B gives that address without the narrative.

The core sayings match: whether the Ansar are not content that people take worldly goods while they take the Prophet home, and that if people took a valley and the Ansar a mountain path he would take the Ansar's path.
B adds a closing not in A (the Ansar are his intimates, and but for the hijra he would have been one of the Ansar), and wording differs (برسول الله / بمحمد, بيوتكم / دياركم, لأخذت / لسلكت).

reasons: Both open with the same frame: three whom God will not speak to, look at or purify on the Day of Resurrection, and who will have a painful punishment.

This is a standard frame filled with different content.
